CREATE TABLE "public"."job_matches" (
  "checks" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "decidedAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "extractionId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "jobId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "matcherVersion" int4 NOT NULL,
  "outcome" text NOT NULL,
  "profileId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "stackScore" numeric(4,3),
  "unverified" bool NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "job_matches_outcome_99dbf9c9" CHECK (outcome IN ('qualified','rejected')),
  CONSTRAINT "job_matches_rejected_verified_42d2b1cf" CHECK (NOT (outcome = 'rejected' AND unverified)),
  CONSTRAINT "job_matches_stack_score_range_75a2340d" CHECK ("stackScore" IS NULL OR "stackScore" BETWEEN 0 AND 1)
)
